title: Kitchens
blurb: Hand-painted and natural timber kitchens, designed for the room and made in the workshop.

title: Bathrooms
blurb: Vanity units, washstands and bathroom cabinetry built to cope with damp and daily use.

title: Cabinetry & Storage
blurb: Wardrobes, alcove units, under-stairs storage and shelving that make the most of awkward spaces.

title: Furniture
blurb: Dining tables, desks, beds and freestanding pieces, made one at a time.

title: Staircases
blurb: Oak staircases, open-tread stairs and spirals, made to fit old houses and new.

title: Windows, Doors & Joinery
blurb: Timber windows, front and internal doors, and fine joinery such as inlaid floors.
